subject: Annual token-commit outline and ask: Starter / Growth / Enterprise options
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@echohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@echohealth.com, Lydia Park <lydia.park@echohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Annual commit tiers — request for clear options and economics

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a concrete annual commit proposal (per-token) we can take to our finance committee. We'd like simple Starter / Growth / Enterprise tier options with:
- committed tokens per year
- list price per-token and discount by tier
- any onboarding/one-time fees and how unused tokens are handled
- credit/true-up and rollover rules

Quick context: EchoHealth is on the hosted API today, ~6M tokens/month currently (embed + chat), expect 35–50% growth next 12 months if latency and cost remain stable. They asked for a conservative Growth tier to start and an Enterprise option (SLA + VPC) as a stretch.

Can you send a short outline and a sticky proposal we can share with finance by EOD Friday? Also include an example cost comparison vs pay-as-you-go.

Thanks — Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Integrations | EchoHealth
procurement@echohealth.com

---
Attachment: EchoHealth_Usage_Snapshot_Q3.csv (CSV summary of monthly token usage, 6 rows)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@echohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual commit tiers — request for clear options and economics

Sanjay — thanks for the clear ask and the usage snapshot. High level first pass below; attaching a tidy PDF and an editable spreadsheet.

Topline (summary):
- Starter: 24M tokens/year (2M/month) — 12% discount vs PAYG
- Growth: 72M tokens/year (6M/month) — 22% discount vs PAYG; includes 1 month of free onboarding support and 1 eval slot for quantization testing
- Enterprise: 240M tokens/year — 32% discount vs PAYG; includes SLA (99.9), optional VPC deployment add-on, and 24/7 priority support

Key rules:
- Unused tokens: 3-month rolling rollover up to 10% of committed tokens; beyond that we provide prorated credit to next year.
- True-up: quarterly true-up at committed pricing for actual overages.
- Billing: monthly invoices against committed drawdown; annual prepay optional for improved discount (additional 2–4%).

I'll let Ben follow up with precise per-token dollar values and worked examples — want to make sure we match EchoHealth's current mix of embeddings vs chat tokens. Sending attached draft now.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood_Annual_Commit_Proposal_v1.pdf, commit-pricing-model.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@echohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual commit tiers — request for clear options and economics

Sanjay — following up with the numbers and a worked example based on the CSV you sent. Short version and then a sample calc: 

Per-token list (PAYG) we currently charge: $0.00075 per token (chat) / $0.00010 per token (embeddings) — blended rate for your mix ~ $0.00048/token.

Proposed commit dollar rates (blended):
- Starter (24M/yr): $0.00042/token (~12% off) — estimated annual cost: $10,080
- Growth (72M/yr): $0.00037/token (~22% off) — estimated annual cost: $26,640
- Enterprise (240M/yr): $0.00033/token (~32% off) — estimated annual cost: $79,200

Sample comparison (Growth tier vs PAYG using 72M tokens):
- PAYG: 72,000,000 * $0.00048 = $34,560
- Growth commit: $26,640 (savings ~ $7,920, ~23%)

Flex items:
- Multi-year prepay adds 2% (2-year) / 4% (3-year) on top of the tier discount.
- VPC/on-prem add-on pricing depends on region and capacity — we can provide a dedicated quote after sizing.

Next steps: confirm target tier (Starter/Growth/Enterprise), and whether EchoHealth wants the 12-month or 24/36-month prepay option. I've attached the pricing model with a per-month drawdown example.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: commit-pricing-model.xlsx (tabbed workbook: summary, monthly-drawdown, uplift-scenarios)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@echohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Annual token-commit outline and ask: Starter / Growth / Enterprise options

Rishi — looping you in to validate margins and confirm whether we can offer an additional introductory concession: 6% extra discount on Growth for year-one if EchoHealth signs a 24-month commit with a 10% annual uplift guarantee. Details below from Ben and the attachments.

Please advise if that concession is doable and any guardrails we should add (min monthly drawdown, non-refundable onboarding credit, etc.). Sanjay — copying you so you're aware we may propose a conditional promotional adjustment.

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 09:25 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (quoted) See attached workbook for the math.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@echohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@echohealth.com, Lydia Park <lydia.park@echohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual token-commit outline and ask: Starter / Growth / Enterprise options

Marissa / Ben / Rishi — appreciate the fast turnaround and the worked examples. EchoHealth is inclined to sign the Growth tier but procurement is pushing for a limited first-year promotion. They asked if you can do 6% additional off the Growth dollar rate for year one (effective blended rate -> $0.000348/token) in exchange for:
- 24-month commit (Growth annual volumes) with a 10% committed uplift optionality at renewal, and
- minimum monthly drawdown of 4M tokens (to avoid very lumpy usage).

If you can accept that promo, procurement will route the SOW and PO next week.

Would you be able to confirm by EOD Friday?

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Integrations | EchoHealth
